title: Unable to open directory from strider - filepicker
body:
stty size: 57 202
zellij: 0.40.0
uname -av: Linux iuxhome 6.8.5-arch1-1 #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 11 Apr 2024 01:47:33 +0000 x86_64 GNU/Linux
zsh --version: 5.9 (x86_64-pc-linux-gnu)
ohmyzsh
powerlevel10k

Step to reproduce:

Add key binding
```
bind "Alt f" {
   LaunchPlugin "filepicker" {
      close_on_selection true
   };
}
```

Press Alt + f to open the filepicker, than,navigate to desired folder:

![Screenshot_20240416_152742](https://github.com/zellij-org/zellij/assets/821668/a3a3e98f-b691-4c5d-bb1f-33605607726f)


Press TAB to select desired folder, in my example zellij:

![Screenshot_20240416_153034](https://github.com/zellij-org/zellij/assets/821668/7e69d8af-4fbd-489d-b23f-1439ac88a8bc)

Press enter to open folder in the right panel, but nothing happens. The position in the right panel doesn't change. Is this behavior correct?

P.s. However, if I select a file, it opens without problems

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: just updated zellij and I'm having this issue too

comments.author: participant3
comments.body: I am using Ubuntu 22.04 and having this issue as well. I install Zellij from the main branch

comments.author: participant4
comments.body: To those experiencing this issue: if you set the `default_shell` in the [config](https://zellij.dev/documentation/configuration) to something (eg. `bash`) and then start a new session, does it work?

comments.author: participant3
comments.body: @participant4 Setting `default_shell` fixes the bug for me. My `$SHELL` is `/bin/bash`, I set the `default_shell` to `bash`

comments.author: participant4
comments.body: Thanks @participant3, I'll fix this in a patch soon. For now, at least we have a temporary workaround.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
@participant4, tryed with `default_shell "zsh"` and `default_shell "/usr/bin/zsh"` but it stil doesn't work form me. 

```
echo $SHELL
/usr/bin/zsh
```

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: maybe problems with zsh / oh-my-zsh / powerlevel10k ?

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: I've just discovered that even though I'm using zsh, setting `default_shell "bash"` solves my problem... Is it correct?

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
@participant4 seems to be some problems with zsh. At the top of my zsh config file I have this, I don't know if it could matter:

```
if [[ ! -v ZELLIJ || ( -v ZELLIJ && $ZELLIJ -eq 1 ) ]]; then
	zellij attach --create default-session
fi
```

to attach zellij to a specific existing session. 

setting `default_shell "bash"` obviously makes me lose zsh when I open panels. On the other hand setting `default_shell "zsh"` introduces a strange behavior. Please, see attached video. As you can see, pressing enter to open a folder, closes the filepicker and breaks the layout. (with default_shell "zsh")


[Screencast_20240417_192108.webm](https://github.com/zellij-org/zellij/assets/821668/213f545a-0a2c-4f0f-b8cf-5203be36dc54)

comments.author: participant5
comments.body: default_shell "fish" works as a workaround for me

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
@participant5 are you using zsh?

According to the documentation, fish should be the default shell. Even when commented out, the behavior should remain the same.

comments.author: participant5
comments.body: @reporter no, I have my `$SHELL` set as `fish` and the filepicker (strider) worked before v0.40 without setting this config, but now I have to explicitly set it for it to work

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: @participant5 the problem seems to be related to zsh. I would like to have more feedback with zsh besides my own

comments.author: participant4
comments.body:
Hi @reporter - I appreciate that you really want this problem fixed, but please don't tag me. This is a large project and I unfortunately do not have the capacity to provide user support to all who need it. I am just one person.

Please see my previous comment about this issue, your problem (given that it happens only in one shell) almost certainly has to do with your environment and the way you launch Zellij.

If you'd like help getting to the bottom of it, please go to one of our dedicated support platforms (Discord and to a lesser extend Matrix).

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
My apologies for tagging you. I just thought you might have a better understanding of the project. By the way, to lunch zellij, I simply put this at the beginning of the ~/.zshrc file

```
if [[ ! -v ZELLIJ || ( -v ZELLIJ && $ZELLIJ -eq 1 ) ]]; then
        zellij attach --create default-session
fi
```

is it a wrong approach?

comments.author: participant4
comments.body: Fixed in https://github.com/zellij-org/zellij/issues/3267 - will release a patch version with this and other fixes in the near future.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: Thanks. Hope this patch will fix also for zsh
